## Purpose
Adapts a `deepagents.create_deep_agent` LangGraph graph to the exact streaming event contract (`chunk`/`usage`/`tool_call`/`tool_result`/`done`/`gate`/`error`) the execution engine already consumes from the legacy `DeepAgent`, so the engine can drive the new deepagents runtime without changing its own dispatch code.

## Shape
- `DeepAgentRunner` — builds the graph in `__init__` (model resolution via `build_model`, filesystem backend rooted at a `RunSandbox`, tool exclusion, HITL `interrupt_on`) and exposes `astream_events`/`astream_with_usage`/`astream`/`run` to reproduce the legacy agent object's interface.
- `_ToolFilterMiddleware` — strips named tools (always `task`, and the full built-in suite for text-only agents) from the model request before the model sees them; a local reimplementation of a deepagents-private middleware, built on public LangChain APIs.
- `_BedrockCachePointsMiddleware` — Bedrock-only middleware that injects `cache_control` so `ChatBedrockConverse` requests get prompt caching (deepagents' built-in caching middleware only covers `ChatAnthropic`).
- `_gate_payload` — post-loop detection of a paused `HumanInTheLoopMiddleware` interrupt via `aget_state`, normalized into a JSON-serializable payload for the engine's review gate.
- `_strip_fabricated_tool_xml` / `_extract_text` / `_cache_token_counts` — output-sanitization and text/usage-extraction helpers.

## Why this shape
The module is explicitly a bridge for an in-progress migration (`specs/002-deepagents-migration/plan.md`): its docstring states it reproduces the legacy `DeepAgent` streaming contract byte-for-byte so a later phase can swap the dispatch with a single change, and it deliberately owns local, public-API-only middleware rather than importing deepagents' private internals so it doesn't break across library releases.
